text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! This chance encounter... I 
can't help feeling it's something akin to 
destiny.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Do you come here often, Desire?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because it somewhat gives off the 
atmosphere of an otherworldly bazaar.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You could say I have a feeling... that you 
can find anything and everything here.
choice_data_list:
Is that so... Are you looking for 
something?

Is that so... Are you looking for 
something?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I recently read a new scripture 
of the Otherworld titled *The Starving 
Saint's Otherworldly Cooking*.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It's an innovative epic where the Saintess 
herself painfully gathers ingredients and 
cooks to regain her lost power.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I had already been curious about the 
cuisine of other worlds, so I made up my 
mind without a moment's hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I shall make them too—dishes from the 
other world! ...Or so I thought.
choice_data_list:
I see. But what will you do about the 
ingredients?
I see. But what about the ingredients?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"As you say, ingredients from another 
realm cannot be obtained in this world."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, based on the cooking process and 
flavor descriptions, we should be able to 
deduce similar ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"With that, I will take on the challenge. 
If I master otherworldly cuisine now, it's 
bound to help me later!"
choice_data_list: If it's okay, let me help too!
If it's okay, let me help too!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, are you quite sure? Thank you so 
much, this is a true godsend!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"First up is this vegetable called the 
Ogre-on. Supposedly, it has a component 
potent enough to make even an ogre weep, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You're right! There was a scene where they 
soaked it in holy water to draw out the 
essence. Let's go buy some right away.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Deep-fried Cockatrice... Since a 
cockatrice is a giant chicken, we could 
probably substitute chicken, but what 
should we do about the snake for a 
tail...?
choice_data_list:
I hear it's somewhere between fish and 
chicken, but...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the tail white meat fish, then. 
Fufu, getting two kinds of meat from a 
single creature... other worlds really are 
fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with Red Desire, I deduced the 
ingredients and gathered them one by one. 
However—
choice_data_list: You really bought a lot, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I was having so much fun 
planning the ingredients, I got carried 
away.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I had intended to try every single dish 
from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if I eat every last bite, well... 
It feels like a rather delicate issue 
might arise.”
choice_data_list:
Should we try to see if we can turn it 
into trail rations or preserved food?
Since we're here, let's eat it all!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My! That is a splendid idea. If we can 
preserve it, we won't end up overeating.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"And above all, this might be our chance 
to let the people from the other world 
taste our ingredients!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This is a new challenge for a saint. I 
shall certainly see it through to 
completion!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By dividing and storing it in small 
portions, Red Desire managed to avoid 
overeating.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh my, are you quite sure!?
choice_data_list:
It's a chance to learn about the 
Otherworld. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Besides?
choice_data_list:
If they do a bigger portion, I'll figure 
something out.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. I shall 
demonstrate my skills to the fullest, so 
please join me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having thoroughly enjoyed the 
other-worldly meal, Red Desire rejoiced, 
believing she was now one step closer to 
becoming a Saint.
